title: Object category decoding from MEG
disposition_reason: A complete current source programme grades known-concept decoding from fixed processed MEG summaries on held people and held exemplars. Authentic full input/header qualification, trusted target custody and complete workload execution remain absent; older three-arm delivery prose is not the V4 four-arm programme.

scientific_target.question: Do fixed 100–300 ms MEG summaries identify known THINGS concepts on held people and held images beyond ocular and missingness information?
scientific_target.known_answer: One of 1,854 source concept IDs for each experimental image/epoch, with exactly two held images per concept and held person.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Official source experimental epoch/image/concept alignment, authenticated privately after complete prediction admission.
scientific_target.case_unit: One held-person/feature-arm inference context; image epochs are nested queries.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Four people BIGMEG1–4; classes, repeated source images and programme replications do not add biological people.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Known-label, unseen-exemplar retrospective decoding from author-processed temporal summaries. It is neither zero-shot category learning nor raw waveform interpretation.
exclusions: No causal 100–300 ms latency boundary after whole-run filtering/ocular preprocessing.
No native waveform or typed-viewer model performance, SOTA, or population-generalization proof.

inputs: 271 MEG means over 100≤t<300 ms plus 271 finite fractions (542 neural features).
Three eye-tracker means plus three finite fractions (6 ocular); joint548; neural_availability271 in current V4.
Training labels/classes and opaque group identifiers only within the isolated held-person view.
forbidden_inputs: Query concept/image IDs, event sequence, session/run names, response keys or stimulus marker channels.
Other folds, query-label feedback, held-person fitting or query-batch transduction.
observation_contract.case_identity: Current cohort creates HMAC-derived opaque aliases; source BIGMEG1–4 identities remain operator-side. Each fold requires 3,708 queries and 55,620 training rows.
observation_contract.split: Hold one person and two globally grouped images per concept out; train on three people × ten other images per concept. Current training selection uses 15 crossed participant/image-group folds; all transformations fit within training only.
observation_contract.coverage: 88,992 experimental rows across four people, 48 sessions, 480 runs. V4 requires 96 candidate plus64 independent-reference prediction matrices across four arms. Full source/header joins are still unverified, including BIGMEG4 session02.

primary.name: Equal-person class-balanced neural Top-1 accuracy
primary.aggregation: Within each person average its two queries per concept, then 1,854 concepts equally, then four people equally; report each mode/replication separately.
primary.rationale: Scores authentic observed-image concept targets while preventing class/subject support imbalance.

secondary: Class-balanced Top-5 and natural-log loss, with zero true-class probability retained as infinity.
Neural-minus-ocular, joint-minus-ocular and neural-minus-availability paired contrasts.
Candidate-minus-training-selected reference and training-investigation-minus-fixed-program contrasts; three computational replications remain nonbiological.

comparators.name: Training-selected ridge/LDA/Fourier-ridge bank
comparators.procedure: Implemented source chooses among three competent-family candidates using inner folds; centroid also retained as a separate reference.

comparators.name: Ocular and neural-availability controls
comparators.inputs: Matched queries with six eye features or271 finite-fraction features
comparators.procedure: Implemented four-arm comparisons distinguish neural signal from eye activity and missingness.

comparators.name: Uniform and training-frequency priors
comparators.procedure: Implemented closed-form priors after exact full-support admission; no extra fitting.

nuisance_controls: Use actual processed FIF headers for271 remaining sensors, not erroneous BIDS channel type fields.
Missing sensor/eye data are explicit finite fractions; preserve every query rather than deleting low-quality held cases.
Repeat/image identities globally grouped and query order opaque; disclose public source exposure.
evaluation.uncertainty: All four person differences and 256 enumerated person bootstrap resamples are descriptive; shared stimuli and n=4 limit population claims.
evaluation.failure_policy: All160 exact matrices and execution/method receipts must validate before target access; reject missing/extra IDs, invalid probabilities or absent classes. No clipping/renormalization or partial-panel promotion.

implementation.scorer_target: True source concept labels for3,708 held images per person; unlike source-table reproduction, this is a legitimate neural decoding target. Scorer includes exact complete probability support and independent reference comparisons.
implementation.delivered_scope: V4 complete-source programme on fixed temporal summaries with training investigation; native headers, signals, target custody and full execution remain unqualified.
missing: Authenticate complete source/derivative mapping and actual clocks/channels, including missing session sidecars.

Supply separately matched raw-observation/direct/viewer condition before claiming those abilities.
